reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: 1st time flying with Corendon and the last we upgraded and paid Premium that advertises on the web site as all inclusive please do not be fooled As we had paid premium I rang Customer services to ask if we could upgrade the seats only to be argued yes argued with that the seats we choose(we didn’t they were allocated) was the ones we had to have she actually said to me are you not understanding me) she obviously didn’t understand Premium service eventually she said fill a form in online ..well that’s an experience trying to find it. Form filled in email back saying you can now book which ever seats you like even front tried to book front but that was extra money again. Arrived at the Manchester Airport asked the staff about priority boarding and premium she looked at us and said Corendon DO NOT do premium so I said what have we paid extra for she said you might get better seats. On the airline we asked the Chief Cabin Crew about Premium only to be told again that Corendon DO NOT do premium anyway he than brought us some food, I said we preordered food he said well this is what you have got Ravioli One Person doesn’t like one person diet restrictions 2 people took it but it was luke warm and not nice supposed to be mushroom but was cheese, so we asked for a drink which we was told you have to pay for drinks but we are premium all inclusive we was told yes does not include drinks 2.5€ for a very small bottle of water. Homeward bound We was served a omelette covered in cheese and swimming in water and again Luke warm. Yes I have complained to Corendon but as it is done via the form online you get the same response read the small print ..drinks not included so what did we pay extra £90 each for they are very quick at taking the extra money but no Premium service supplied. In one response from the complaint they have asked for a screen shot of the meals booked as they have no record, who would screen shot that as we trusted Corendon…..Please avoid at all costs
reviews.author: janet

reviews.title: Best crew I ever met
reviews.text: Today it was a best crew ever! Really very kind, profesional to me and my 1 year old baby. Thank you for today flight. In The end I forgot some staff in plane but personal was looking at me and ask to people who forgot this and this when we were waitting for a bus. Many thanks. 1* We had a suprise from cabin crew for a first flight my daughter.
reviews.author: Marcela

reviews.title: Not as bad
reviews.text: Reading reviews I was afraid it is the worst airline company in the world. My experience wasn't bad at all. I started worrying when I couldn't check-in online using both website and the app despite receiving SMS to do so. Check-in at counter was easy and free, we were seated next to kids, no issues here. Leg space was very standard. Departure was on time, luggage was neither lost not damaged.
reviews.author: Evgeny

reviews.title: Mr Silan
reviews.text: My flight was at 1500 on 27/05/2023, everything was fine , booking , checking on line, at the airport they refused to let us check in for the reason that there is over booking and we have to wait till last passenger then they decide, they been very aggressive, the airlines office in London and they refused, they put bunch of uneducated women they have no respect to the age , myself 76 years old and my wife 70 years old, I decided to take them to the court. I never recommend this air line to any human.
reviews.author: sydney S

reviews.title: Rude flight attendant!!
reviews.text: Bad service rude flight attendant i ask for something and she told me "dont tell me that.. im doing my job!" Soo rude!!! Wait 1 hour in The plane for take off.. but its o if it was good service .. we wont flight with u anymore! amateurs !!
reviews.author: Chen B

reviews.title: Checked in on line to find my 7 old seated on her own 4 rows away my thirteen  year old even farther away the plane had
reviews.text: Checked in on line only to find my 7 year old seater 4 rowd away my 13 year old even feather away plenty of empty seats could have seated us all together just away to make yo spend more money what morons would seat a7 year old away from her parents blatant profiteering not happy
reviews.author: Garry C

reviews.title: I must be one of the lucky ones!
reviews.text: I was a little worried when I read some of the reviews after booking my holiday but I needn't have worried. I was able to check in for both the outward journey and inward journey. I was able to sit with my family. There was a delay in setting off but that was due to Manchester Airport having issues with checking in luggage. Based upon my round trip, I would fly with Coredon again.
reviews.author: Yasmin A

reviews.title: Awful customer service🤬
reviews.text: Pathetic customer service. They destroyed my suitcase and offered me £30 to replace it! They said if I wasn't satisfied with this to take the damaged case to a repair specialist and get a quote. Last time this happened to me was with Tui, it took them 3 days to resolve things and send me a replacement. This useless lot, have taken 2 months to reach a very unsatisfactory outcome. Beware this pathetic company. Needless to say, I won't be flying again with them and I will share this story on all social media platforms. 🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬
reviews.author: Mike38

reviews.title: Great value for money and flight times
reviews.text: When booking our flight to Antalya we picked the times that suited my husband and myself. I had never heard of this airline and the were some bad reviews but we went ahead and booked it, with some caution. We checked in on line both ways so we did not get charged the check in fee. The bag drop off was fine, and we departed on time. The cabin crew were very professional and the space between rows was no problem for my 6ft 2 husband, the beverage service was absolutely fine and the food was hot. Great flight absolutely no problems. Can only state as I found the flight.
reviews.author: Barbara R

reviews.title: Extra each person 10EUR to check you in! Scam
reviews.text: Extra each person 10EUR to check you in! Scam They will charge you at the airport extra each person 10EUR to check you in! The service overall catastrophe!!!
reviews.author: Atalay

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: They extra charged people for non-sense reasons, I paid 10 Euro just for checking. Thery do not mention clearly this payment before check-in. They do not accept debit cards and also reluctant to change your money and give the rest money back.
reviews.author: pooria t

reviews.title: Disgusting airline
reviews.text: Firstly the airport staff are completely useless and very rude. Secondly thier online check-in doesn't work and because of this they charge €10 per person for check in claiming its because we booked economy seats. I dont know if they are thick or just dont know who they work for as corendon is an economy airline. Due to thier website not functioning properly I was forced to withdraw £50 euros from an atm using a credit card causing me extra unnecessary charges. If they want to charge for check-in they could at least have a card reader to hand. We were told to stand to one side and someone would come to help us when in reality they were just fobbing us off and no one helped us. 90% of passengers had to pay this charge. Steer clear!
reviews.author: James A

reviews.title: Pretty good
reviews.text: Flew to Dalaman and back with Corendon. Both flights bang on time. Food and drinks served within a hour of take off. Very impressed
reviews.author: Richard

reviews.title: Terrible customer service.
reviews.text: I wasn't able to check in online prior to my flight, the website kept crashing and when I finally got through and put all the passengers details, I received an error message saying online checking wasn't available for my flight... I called customer service who said I should go to the airport and show the staff at the checkin desks the error message. I was met with very rude staff including the manager who said I had to pay for check in (despite the error message) otherwise I couldn't board the flight! The attitude of the staff was very unhelpful and rude, they forced me, along with a lot of passengers who were in the same situation, to pay 20 euros per person to print a boarding pass. Then someone turned up and said they had booked with TUI and didn't have a boarding pass, somehow it was alright for them and they didn't have to pay.... I submitted a complain online (good luck finding where on the website to submit a claim) and received an automated reply to say someone would come back to me in 6 to 8 weeks. Clearly terrible customer experience and I will never fly with Corendon again!
reviews.author: Virginie C

reviews.title: Worst experience of my life
reviews.text: Makes Ryan air look like a Michelin star restaurant. Embarrassing from start to finish. 3hrs until we got a drink Waited 3 hours for our luggage. 3/16 suitcases lost 2/16 golf clubs lost Absolutely disgusting airline
reviews.author: bruce w

reviews.title: Paul B
reviews.text: Read the reviews prior to flying and was concerned to what i could be walking in to. However several updates from the pilot along the way, attentive cabin crew. Just as good as other budget airlines Easyjet, Ryan Air. Would recommend and fly with again.
reviews.author: Paul B

reviews.title: Conned
reviews.text: Just flew with Corendon from Newcastle to Anyalya recently on a 10 day holiday,i could not check in on line on the outbound journey as there was no facility to do do ,coming back from Antalya online check in was showing not open even at the airport but they still charged everyone on the flight £10 because they did not check in online ???.I complained direct to Coredon on through their own complaints dept and in the two weeks i have been back in the country i have heard NOTHING, this company are nothing but thieves, i would avoid them at all cost because in the end it will cost you.
reviews.author: Denise G

reviews.title: ABSOLUTE SCAMMERS
reviews.text: Do not fly with this airline!! Absolute scammers. They split families up on purpose and you have to pay a fortune to sit with your children. All different areas of the plane. Completely unacceptable. Would not go anywhere near this airline again.
reviews.author: Ben W

reviews.title: Ignore flight times
reviews.text: Please please do not use Corendon. We booked our flights with them as the return flight from Antalya was 11am unlike other airlines which are in the middle of the night or very early and surprise surprise they have just moved our flight from 11am to 7.50! Strange they only informed us once we arrived. I knew it was coming as I had checked the airlines schedules for Sundays and they only have one flight at ... 07.50. So if you are thinking of using them as the flight times are better don't. The reason I knew it was going to happen was due to the fact they did the same last year!!! The screen shot was taken before I recieved the change details, Corendon well aware the 11am flight did not exist! But waited till I am in Turkey to tell me? I am lucky I was prepared for this but sure 100s were not.
reviews.author: Kevin S

reviews.title: Force Majeure 😡
reviews.text: Booked a TUI vacation to Antalya on 26/04/23, flying DIRECT with Corendon ...or so we thought !! Oh no, we received an email ( some passengers didnt get notification) of a flight change , no reason as to why the flight was going to take 0ver 6 hours instead of 4 and departing later. Found out eventually , no longer a direct flight , we were stopping off at Bristol to offload and pick up . After a small delay from Newcastle , we landed at Bristol, and waited and waited and waited and waited and ......... Passengers were waiting to disembarque, over 1 hour they waited finally, they were allowed off the plane. THEN we waited and waited and waited and..... not one piece of information was given, no food or water offered, " :Anything over two hours should entail the provision of care services. In this case, your airline must provide food and drink We were sat on the tarmac at Bristol almost 4 hours with nothing offered. NO food onboard !!. Still no information until a passenger took it upon herself to use her phone and try to find out what the issue was. Finally Bristol passengers were allowed to board. A Bristol airport staff member tried to explain why the situation arose, basically it was lack of communication between the three parties- Antalya-Newcastle-Bristol .. Therefore I cannot understand why my delay compensation was rejected by Corendon citing FORCE MAJEURE . What a load of rubbish. Human error ,unless there was an outbreak of hostilities between the 3 airports🤣 Corendon stated the delay was 3hours 49minutes, maybe it was when we landed but I believe the actual time of arrival is when the plane doors are opened and passengers are allowed to disembarque, this was 04:20 , I can remember looking at my watch ! The flight crew had been working for over 14 hours 🥱 Filling in a flight irregularity form is pointless. My reply from Corendon " This is a matter which includes authority decision (Border Force) and therefore is to be handled as Force Majeure. Due to exceptional circumstances, there is no entitlement to compensation here. Since when was human error /lack of paperwork an exceptional circumstance. Why wasnt all paper work cleared before takeoff in Antalya?
reviews.author: JULIE T

reviews.title: No complaints here!!
reviews.text: We were really worried after reading some of these reviews to the point where I didn’t want to go on holiday anymore. Genuinely we didn’t have a single issue. We checked in online which is clear in all of their communications and if your airport doesn’t offer it then you don’t get charged so not sure how anyone can be offended by this. Our hold bags were free which is a bonus. Check in at Manchester was easy, boarding was done in rows and we took off on time. Flight to Antalya was 25 mins shorter than advertised. The plane was a little dirty but it was a quick turn around and on the return leg they did ask over the tannoy for everyone to give their rubbish in to help them get the plane as tidy as possible. Food and drinks on board were nice, same prices as UK airlines although I’d recommend taking cash as card machine was hit and miss but they accepted UK and Euro currency. Staff were fine, helpful whenever we needed anything. Captain gave announcements before, during and just prior to descent. Little screens popped down showing speed, altitude and a live map! Plane was comfortable, no different from UK airlines short haul planes. People complaining about no leg room have clearly never flown EasyJet or Ryanair etc because it is literally the same. No complaints whatsoever and a lot of needless anxiety caused by bad reviews.
reviews.author: 499549LM

reviews.title: Don’t let the poor reviews put you off
reviews.text: After reading all the bad reviews it put me off flying with them but it was all in all a good flight. The staff were friendly and helpful. I think their sometimes bluntness is more a language issue, I didn’t find them rude at all. The plane was clean and relatively comfortable. Similar to Ryanair and EasyJet, and really not too dissimilar to TUI and Jet2. The flight times are so much better than the other airlines, especially as we flew with a toddler and baby. So nice to get home at 1pm then 1am! The flights were on time too, no issues there at all. The main issue people had was they didn’t check in online which they were then charged at the airport. Their website is pretty clear about which airports you can do online check in with so it’s not really the airlines fault. Overall I would say they’re just as good as other airlines.
reviews.author: Anon

reviews.title: Never Again!
reviews.text: My husband and I have just had the misfortune to fly with this airline. We booked with Thomas Cook and this was the airline they choose to use and we had already paid our deposit before we realised. I have never been on such an awful flight ever! We were rammed in like sardines, my husband who is average height just about had his knees under his chin. The seats were narrow too so you became well acquainted with your neighbour. The aircraft was far too hot and the air conditioning was totally inadequate. There was no in-flight entertainment, not even the usual booklet in the seat pockets. Menus of the food they were selling were not available so the in-flight service took forever which inconvenienced anyone wanting to use one of the two toilets aboard. It was packed with children, I have never known so many children on a flight given it was not school holidays, most of who screamed and cried for all four and half hours. The adults weren’t much better as they too seemed to have no volume control either. The staff made no effort to ask parents to control their children or to assist with suggestions of how distract them or ease their distress. I have flown with football fans after a long delay at Heathrow and that was far less noisy. We thought the flight out was maybe just bad luck, however the return flight was just as awful. One minor plus, we had none of the much mentioned problems with the online check-in.
reviews.author: Lorraine W

reviews.title: Uncomfortable
reviews.text: 1st time flying with them to Turkey and return flight No leg room,cheap and uncomfortable, not even the usual im bored so ill read the magazine in chair pouch.Unfreindly cabin crew ,would never use again.
reviews.author: Jason N

reviews.title: Smooth flight
reviews.text: Our first experience with Corendon Airlines and very impressed with the quality of speed of flight, comfort onboard and being ontime with take off and arrival. Recommend Corendon to have more staff on check in desks as very long time checking in. Otherwise super.
reviews.author: Brod S

reviews.title: Old planes
reviews.text: We have flown with corendon airlines 3 times now and have the same compliant. Leg room is very limited and the seats recline when you don’t want them too which is not nice for the person behind you. The air con is also hit and miss.
reviews.author: Paul S

reviews.title: Do NOT fly
reviews.text: Still waiting one year after a +3 hours delay for the compensation. Corendon Airlines approved of the compensation within a few months - but I have been waiting ever since, for the actual compensation … Called and wrote many complaints - but nothing. A week ago they wrote me if i instead of the compensation, would like a voucher? Well. No thanks. You don’t even fly from Copenhagen anymore? Every review I have made, has been answered by Corendon with a standard reply as “we will forward your complaint to the right department” and “please understand that we can not reply on your case on social media bla bla bla”. It is embarrassing … Nobody takes responsibility!
reviews.author: Christine D
reviews.route: Copenhagen - Las Palmas de Gran Canaria

reviews.title: Airlines a joke and not a funny one
reviews.text: 2 hours to get checked in at Glasgow as they had 3 ques with to people manging them. Flights ok usual budget airline no leg room no I'm flight entertainment. Wouldn't let you check in online on the way as it states on the booking in page your flight does not support online checking. So keep that in mind on the way back in Antalya they charged us 10Euros per head because we hadn't checked in online. When I tried explaining the situation no cares give was told its because "you bought the cheap tickets" never again if it can be helped. TUKISH AIRLINES NEED TO START DOING FLIGHT TO ANTALYA AGAIN!
reviews.author: Adiel

reviews.title: Flight cancelled!!
reviews.text: Flight time was changed 6weeks before holiday, then cancelled altogether 4 weeks before. No explanation given. Not good as caused a lot of panic just before a long awaited trip
reviews.author: Helen Jade

reviews.title: DO NOT LET THE BAD REVIEWS PUT YOU OFF FROM FLYING WITH THIS AIRLINE
reviews.text: This is a genuine review: we flew to Antalya on 05/05/23. we booked it a few weeks before & after booking i read all the reviews about this airline & ill be honest it put us off and also scared as we were flying with an infant. People have degraded this airline so bad it it unbelievable. IT IS BETTER THEN EASYJET & JET2 PUT TOGETHER!!! Better/newer aircrafts great service normal leg room (could be better) good customer service they could do better cleaning after each flight & also they charge extra 25 euros for the front seats with extra legroom. they could have better entertainment in the aircraft and also external cameras for visuals. WE WOULD FLY WITH THIS AIRLINE OVER & OVER AGAIN.
reviews.author: Israr A

reviews.title: Just awful!!
reviews.text: Once again sat delayed on the tarmac of NIA. The sheer lack of simple communication is unbelievable and unacceptable. Almost an hour now with one announcement which no one could hear. Everyone needing toilet but unable to leave seats. No idea how long this will last this time. I will not be flying with this awful airline again. Poor beyond comprehension!
reviews.author: Julie W

reviews.title: Still waiting to be refunded
reviews.text: I booked a flight for my family in July 2022 , the flight was delayed for over 6 hours with no explanation. Once we boarded the plane, we sat in our seats, and the plane didn't take off for another hour. We traveled with very small children, the plane was so hot, and we were only offered one small cup of warm water. The Airline acknowledged the stress caused during that trip , by agreeing on the compensation but not the added stress of having to communicate with a company that has bad communication with their customers. We are still waiting for our refund almost a year later and they are basically giving us the runaround. It’s not fair don’t waste your time or money with Corendon airlines
reviews.author: TAD

reviews.title: Would not fly with them again
reviews.text: First time flying with this company and would never fly with Corendon again. Flight time changed by 9 hours, notified of this a month before travel - annoying as means we would lose a whole day in a hotel which wasn’t cheap which we had paid for. But out of our control so just got on with this and tried to think of the benefits of a benefits of a night flight……. When we got to the airport and checked in, once through security saw on the board flight was delayed by an hour. Fine. Then advised to go to gate which was down a very long corridor down stairs. Room was very cold, waited and waited hoping to board the plane that we could see on the runway. Then had a very brief announcement to say ‘there are delays, not sure why and not sure how long’ that was it, staff disappeared, zero communication for the next 4 hours - this was now 10pm. Only information we heard was from other passengers who had been out of the gate and tried to get info from airport staff. Turns out the plane came from Turkey and was meant to come straight to Bristol but stopped off at Newcastle and some passengers got on. Border force were not aware of this , as cordon messed up so this meant the passengers could not leave the plane on the run way until border force did checks this took over 4 hours. We were kept in this room with Very limited access to food or water apart from a small vending machine. Really poorly customer service. There were people with disabilities/ mobility issues that could not get up the stairs therefore couldn’t go to the toilet without having to call airport staff to take them in a airport transfer van to a bathroom. It was an absolute shambles. My advice would be to book with another airline if possible.
reviews.author: Kate C

reviews.title: Was actually ok
reviews.text: So I was very worried about flying with this airline due to all the negative reviews. I flew out to Turkey last week and the flight was on time an eveything went ahead as normal. The only thing I would say is to have confirmation of any extra luggage u paid for as at the check in we were told we did not pay for extra baggage and we would be charged. But i had the screenshot on my phone an showed them which they then confirmed is fine. Also on the flight they do not accept visa debit an only Accept cash an credit card. But apart from this eveything else was fine, flight was on time the plane was clean. Main reason I left this review is to give reassurance to other mums who are travelling with kids. As I was so nervous due to all the bad reviews online an wanted to cancel. Glad I went ahead and had an amazing holiday.
reviews.author: Ruksar

reviews.title: dont pay out promise/agreed compensation.
reviews.text: After long delayed on flight and lack… After long delayed on flight and lack information from Corendon, they have agreed to pay compensation. This could that up to 12 week to revive Payment, now 12 week lave no payment and no feedback/contact from them
reviews.author: Thomas R

reviews.title: Avoid these scammers!
reviews.text: In a nutshell, these lot a total scammers from the get go. They post attractive times, you book and pay more than the reputable airlines for convenience. Then what they do is email you that your times have changed. They charge extra fees left right and centre, strand people, send them to different locations than where they want to go. They disable the online check in system so that they can charge you extra at desk and refuse to let you on the plane if you don’t pay so they’re basically holding you hostage. Then there’s the timekeeping, they conveniently miss their departure slot and then have you locked in the plane for hours on end! Just trust me and stay away from this operator and stick to the the usual ones you’d consider that are known quantities to you!
reviews.author: Shak

reviews.title: Plane held by uk border force due to flight paperwork
reviews.text: Terrible delays no communication to passengers held at gate for 4 hours with no food or water provided at all. Spent over 2 hours filling in complaint forms but you can not send as it says fill in but it is all filled in total shambles arrived at hotel 6.30am next day I'll for another day so 2 days of our 7 day holiday missed. Can not get any one at Corendon to speak to or ring us. Never ever again !
reviews.author: Wendy A

reviews.title: Hidden Charges at Check in (even when booked by TUI
reviews.text: be very careful to checkin on line with the Airline even if you have booked you package through TUI we were charged 120 euro for not doing this. even though the online checkin service said that our flight couldnt be done online very rude staff at checkin and on the flight
reviews.author: warees1

reviews.title: Turkish hospitality in the Air
reviews.text: I was very impressed by the standards on board the aircraft and by the amazing Crew. my sincere thank you to all the staff of this airline, my companion broke her leg during our holiday. I contacted the airline, it was during Eid, Bayrum holiday, they were so helpful in organising wheelchair assistance in both Antalya and London airports. They changed the seating for my friend so she sits in the front giving her 3 seats so she can elevate her leg else she would have been in pain. they changed my seat as well to the front so I can be close to her. I will definitely fly again with Corenden. Very pleased with their cabin luggage allowance, better than similar budget airlines. once again a Big thank you.
reviews.author: swift_tara

reviews.title: Awful airline AVOID
reviews.text: Booked through TUI flight time changed from 2pm until 6pm,without any notice to us,then when we got to the airport, flight was continually delayed didn't leave until after 10pm, no information from the staff at the airport. The flight had been on the tarmac with passengers from Newcastle still on there all that time,some issue with border force and corendon. The food was horrific stale bread, and a bowl of vegetables for £7, this was refunded, I believe to try and passify us. The crew were rude and refused to give the poor people from Newcastle even a glass of water, disgusting attitude they were all complaining about how long their shift had been not bothered about any of the passengers. We lost a day of our week holiday and I would NEVER use Corendon again it is a shambles. We couldn't complete outbound check in and then were charged £20 to check in going home, without being told by tui rep or anyone else that on line check in was possible. The worst airline I have ever flown with. We are raising a claim against Corendon, with the help of tui so we will see how that goes.
reviews.author: Bev O'Rourke

reviews.title: Terrible service, 9 since my flight months and still not received approved compensation
reviews.text: My flight was delayed for well over 3 hours, complaint registered in August 2022 and approved in December 2022 and 9 months later still not received compensation. I have emailed (no response) and phoned the call centre who advise they can't help.
reviews.author: Tom Stevenson

reviews.title: Terrible experience for autistic people
reviews.text: Had terrible experience with Corendon, was accompanying my autistic partner to get him checked in but after 40 minutes in the queue (there was no special service queue) I had to leave him alone. When he reached the check in desk, the lady who serviced him made him pay €10 for the seat catching him off guard and not explaining anything because she didn’t speak English. When I tried calling on the phone to talk to the service lady, they refused to talk to me and ignored his request for special assistance, and so there was absolute zero support for an autistic person with this airline.
reviews.author: Anastasia N

reviews.title: Terrible staff.
reviews.text: Flew home from Turkey with Corendon Airways. Their card machine was not working, so they were only taking cash. We had none, so I asked for a cup of water and was refused. 4 and a half hours without a drink. They eventually gave another passenger some water for their children, after much complaining.Only one small cup each though. I have never felt such contempt from air crew, they just ignored us, I will never give them my business again.
reviews.author: Denise M

reviews.title: Absolutely dreadful experience , just do not use
reviews.text: Had an awful experience After booking flight from Bristol was moved back four hours on flight XC 2333 ,flight also late and arrived at resort at 2am Then less than two weeks before holiday return flight was diverted to Brisol via Newcastle , extra two hours to original booking Then on the day home with flight delays , Immigration issues,we had to go through UK Immigration twice !! , and further border issues customs confusion turned into nine hour flight back home. An absolute shambles
reviews.author: Robert S

reviews.title: Promised refund due to delayed flight 8 months ago & still waiting!!
reviews.text: Flight delayed several hours. No information or updates or food vouchers. Flight was July. They agreed the compensation in September and said payment would be made. Just received another message over 6 months later saying payment delayed due to “intensity” and offered vouchers. Still no sign of compensation due….Time to contact the civil aviation authority….
reviews.author: Carol

reviews.title: Avoid this airline! Awful customer service and policies
reviews.text: 6 weeks before our flight date I received a text message from Corendon stating that they had changed our flight time by more than 7 hours. The text was very short and not very helpful but generally a flight tume change wouldnt bother me but 7 hours was a very significant change to our travel plans and would have big impact on our holiday for the following reasons: We would now be departing London Gatwick late at night and landing at Dalaman at 2am with two young children - something we would never have chosen to do. We would not be able to get the transportation we had planned from Dalaman airport to our villa accommodation at that unsociable time. We would be arriving a day later than we were expecting and losing a day of our holiday. For all of these reasons we could not accept the rescheduled flight time as it was not a comparable flight to the one that we originally booked. Unfortunately it was the only Corendon flight available that day so I requested a cancellation or at the very least credit to book another flight another time. It was then i discovered that we would only be receiving 50% of the amount we paid. I called customer service because clearly it's not fair that we were being penalised because they had changed the flight time by more than 7 hours a day. I got a 'computer says no' response from the person on the other end of the phone and she just kept saying "that's the policy". I have since tried to email Corendon and also contact them via social media to escalate the compliant but keep getting auto responses telling me to call customer service (who won't listen/ don't want to help). We're talking about a lot of money here and the airline has absolutely no regard for the inconvenience or poor service it is providing its customers. I am still trying to push for a full refund but safe to say we have learnt from our mistake and will never book with Corendon ever again.
reviews.author: lvm1982

reviews.title: XR288 Cancelled in the airport
reviews.text: The flight was delaying at the airport multiple time, and after 6 hours of the original departure time, the flight was cancelled. Now we have issue to claim our hotel costs back due to Corendon refused to provide the reason of cancellation. Please help!
reviews.author: MS

reviews.title: Hidden fees. Awful service
reviews.text: Just returned from a wonderful holiday in Turkey. Ruined by Corendon check in staff charging a full plane of passengers a check in fee. Thete is no option to check in when flying from Glasgow. Just to reiterate that the charge was on return flight. To add insult the on board service was a shambles. They left passengers waiting hours for refreshments trolley causing dehydration with no water in a very hot plane. I will raise a formal complaint regarding the unfair charge for check in. Will never fly with this company again.
reviews.author: suz75Glasgow

reviews.title: BETTER THAN JET2,EASYJET AND RYANAIR!!!!
reviews.text: Don't know why people are not rating this airline? Online check-in was easy our party of 9 got all sat together there is defiantly more leg room than the 3 listed airlines in the title. The plane we was on was a new 737 with drop down TV and mood LED lighting. Th e flight time was great usually 4.40hrs going but was 3.55hrs coming home was usually 5hrs and was 4.10hrs. This is because the 3 named airlines above all fly in eco mode to save money on fuel which makes your flight longer. Our flight was flying at nearly 1000kph both ways. I will be making sure that my next holiday to Turkey we will defiantly be using Corendon again.
reviews.author: LUFC L

reviews.title: additional Fee
reviews.text: It's the first time I've had to pay at check-in. Nowhere was it mentioned that I had to do an online check-in beforehand. If so then it was hidden. The condition must be visibly communicated with an email.
